user.title: Jev Conversation
user.description: Czech Assist agent on TypeSafe Jev. Works through OpenRouter or the TypeSafe API.

data_description.model: Pin a version so thresholds stay valid. OpenRouter: typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917, TypeSafe: jev-1.13.0
data_description.execute_threshold: At or above this, the command runs (locks, alarms and garage or gate covers always ask first).
data_description.ask_threshold: Between this and the execute threshold it asks back; below it answers that it did not understand.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the API address, or the model id was not accepted.
error.ask_above_execute: The ask threshold must be lower than the execute threshold.
